requirement.description: The __setstate__ method has issues with handling different pickle formats, particularly default-style pickles that contain a tuple with None as first element and a dict as second element.
requirement.contract: Fix the __setstate__ method to properly handle both legacy pickle formats (tuple with SplitResult) and default-style pickle formats (tuple with None and dict containing "_val"). The method should correctly reconstruct the URL object from either format without breaking existing functionality.

requirement.description: The path property doesn't handle cases where the URL is constructed with an empty path correctly, causing issues with URL comparison and hash calculation in pickle scenarios.
requirement.contract: Ensure the path property correctly handles empty paths for both absolute and relative URLs, returning "/" for absolute URLs without path components and empty string for relative URLs without path components.

requirement.description: The __hash__ method has issues with handling legacy pickle formats and tuple representations that don't match the expected SplitResult structure.
requirement.contract: Update the __hash__ method to properly handle various pickle formats including tuples with different structures and ensure consistent hash calculation regardless of how the URL object was constructed (including from pickle).

requirement.description: The test_with_suffix_encoded_url test is failing due to issues with how URL objects are constructed when they have empty paths and fragment/query components.
requirement.contract: Ensure URL construction properly initializes all internal state variables (especially _cache) when creating URLs with empty paths, particularly in relation to suffix manipulation operations.
